protocol.question: E77 redesigned: split the rail ledger's 0.875 pJ 'regulators' delivery loss plus logic in step with the rails' row into regulator conduction loss (carries 1/V^2 in the total current) and logic (does not), from matched minion-rail watts at two rail voltages, with the 800 MHz operating-point step fitted (E77's post hoc finding, now registered) and the ladder re-cut on E77's measured per-hart costs.
protocol.design_source: docs/reports/data/2026-10-27-q129-rail-ledger/E77-PLAN.md, as E77 registered it (docs/reports/data/2026-11-01-e77-rail-one-temperature/README.md), with the re-run list of E77's corrections (F1-F6) and its open issues

binaries_sha256.source: E77's session.json sha256 (docs/reports/data/2026-11-01-e77-rail-one-temperature/raw/session.json): the same heater, kernel and no-PMIC-read telemetry build

sampler.profile: no-PMIC-read (ettelem-e77: no GET_ASIC_VOLTAGE, no GET_MODULE_VOLTAGE, no statistics reset)

A.what: 600 MHz at about 518 mV: the static TDP level at 0 (the vmin-LUT floor pin, E72's and E77's write on this card)

heater.note: fp32 randn on 1,024 harts at 600 MHz, about 51 W on the board (E77's own heater); it plateaus near 58-59 C, so E77's 59 C preheat took 5.7 heats a launch and failed 5 gates

B.what: 800 MHz at about 618 mV: the card's own governor at its own 65 W / 65 C

heater.note: fp32 randn on 768 harts at 800 MHz, as E77 (its highest board reading, 70.7 W, was this heater)

passes.order: B1 B2 | set TDP 0 | A1 A2 A3 A4 A5 SETTLE | restore TDP 65 | RETURN B3 B4 B5
passes.pairing: pass k of arm A with pass k of arm B, k = 1..5 (the unit of replication)

settling.note: E77's 8 s rung of arm A's top rung (now 992 harts), after arm A's passes, at the new gate (E77's failed its 59 C preheat)

return_burst.note: after the restore, one launch of arm B's top rung (416 harts): the clock must step up to 800 MHz and the ring dumped after it must hold at least one throttle-up entry NEWER than the dump before it (by service-processor timestamp)

gate.note: E77's gate with E77's own temperatures read off its telemetry: arm A's heater plateaus near 58-59 C (preheat 59 took 5.7 heats a launch, 5 gates failed) and both arms fell to 53-55 C during the ~10 s the rails need to settle. Here: heat until the die mean reads >= 56 C, then idle until it reads <= 55 C, >= 6 s after the last device process, with the minion rail settled by S2's test computed live; a die that falls below 52 C first is heated again (at most 3 times), after which the launch goes ahead at its reading, flagged below_floor. Expected launch readings about 52-55 C in both arms

cuts_card_min.note: card-minutes since the session took the lock; a pass is cut by whole rounds; the restore and the return burst are never cut; the runner's hard stop is 46 card-min (the 50 card-minute budget less the gate reads and the smoke) and 23:25 PST

identity.rule: the module uptime (DM_CMD_GET_MODULE_UPTIME, RAM) must exceed the minutes since the anchor: no service-processor reset since, so the identity read then still names the running image

safety.die_rule: the die mean (minshire[0]) on any reading
safety.high_rule: the die high-water latch (minshire[2], E69 A1: not a live reading)
safety.pin_rule: while the TDP is 0, any minion clock other than 600 MHz during a measurement launch
